sc_equip_brine_ward_cloak.name: Brine-Ward Cloak
sc_equip_brine_ward_cloak.description: Wearer takes 2 less salt damage and 1 less physical damage.

sc_equip_cairn_horn.name: Cairn Horn
sc_equip_cairn_horn.description: Wearer gains the Cairn Horn ability, granting Emboldened to allies in radius 2 for 2 turns.

sc_equip_stairwardens_plate.name: Stair-Warden's Plate
sc_equip_stairwardens_plate.description: Wearer gains +3 hp, +2 defense and takes 1 less pressure damage.

hc_equip_stalklamp.name: Stalk-Lamp Lantern
hc_equip_stalklamp.description: Grants Lamp Flash: apply Darkened and Lured for 1 turn at range 2-4.

hc_equip_resonant_clapper.name: Resonant Clapper
hc_equip_resonant_clapper.description: +1 attack. Grants Bell Shock: adjacent enemies take 3 flat pressure damage.

hc_equip_deep_heart.name: Heart of the Deep
hc_equip_deep_heart.description: +6 hp, resist 2 physical, and returns once on death with 30 percent hp.

rt_equip_oilskin_cloak.name: Oilskin Cloak
rt_equip_oilskin_cloak.description: Wearer takes 2 less brine damage and has +2 hp.

rt_equip_barnacle_mail.name: Barnacle Mail
rt_equip_barnacle_mail.description: Wearer gets +2 defense and takes 1 less physical damage.

rt_equip_drowners_gaff.name: Drowner's Gaff
rt_equip_drowners_gaff.description: Wearer gains Gaff Haul: deal attack physical damage at range 2 to 4 and pull the target 2 tiles.

rt_equip_lungful_of_sea.name: Lungful of Sea
rt_equip_lungful_of_sea.description: Wearer gains Exhale the Deep: 4 brine damage and Soaked to all adjacent enemies, and +2 hp.

rt_equip_second_tide_shroud.name: Second Tide Shroud
rt_equip_second_tide_shroud.description: Wearer gets +1 defense and returns once after death with 40 percent of its hp.

sv_equip_lucky_lantern.name: Lucky Lantern
sv_equip_lucky_lantern.description: Grants Lantern Flash (mark an enemy within 2-4 range).

sv_equip_oilskin_coat.name: Oilskin Coat
sv_equip_oilskin_coat.description: Reduces fire damage taken by 2 and grants +1 HP.

sv_equip_harpoon_gauntlet.name: Harpoon Gauntlet
sv_equip_harpoon_gauntlet.description: +1 attack and grants Grapple Haul (pull an enemy up to 2 tiles).

sv_equip_hull_plate_cuirass.name: Hull-Plate Cuirass
sv_equip_hull_plate_cuirass.description: +2 defense, +4 HP, and reduces physical damage taken by 2.

ra_equip_heartstone_geode.name: Heartstone Geode
ra_equip_heartstone_geode.description: +2 hp. Returns the wearer once on death with 40% of its max hp.

ra_equip_tidal_husk.name: Tidal Husk
ra_equip_tidal_husk.description: +1 defense. Resist brine 3 and fire 2. Grants Husk Pulse.

lk_equip_signal_horn.name: Keeper's Signal Horn
lk_equip_signal_horn.description: Grants Signal Flare: allies in radius 2 gain Emboldened for 2 turns.

lk_equip_stairwell_greaves.name: Stairwell Greaves
lk_equip_stairwell_greaves.description: +1 defense, +1 jump and resist 1 physical damage.

lk_equip_first_lens.name: The First Lens
lk_equip_first_lens.description: +1 attack and grants Prism Beam: deal attack+2 light damage to enemies in radius 1 of a target at range 2-4.

oc_equip_gill_bladder.name: Gill-Bladder
oc_equip_gill_bladder.description: +4 hp. A second, pulsing bladder swells under the gills.

oc_equip_lure_stalk.name: Lure Stalk
oc_equip_lure_stalk.description: Grants Lure Tug: pull an enemy within 2-4 two tiles toward the bearer.

oc_equip_hookskin.name: Hookskin
oc_equip_hookskin.description: +1 defense and resist 1 physical damage. Barbed denticles push up through the skin.

oc_equip_parasite_crown.name: Parasite Crown
oc_equip_parasite_crown.description: +2 attack, -2 hp. A louse rides the bearer's head and eats while it bites.

oc_equip_belly_lantern.name: Belly Lantern
oc_equip_belly_lantern.description: +1 AP and +1 attack. A lit lure swells on the underside, pulling the whole body toward the light.

oc_equip_drowned_heart.name: Drowned Heart
oc_equip_drowned_heart.description: Grants Weep: heal the bearer 4 and make it Wet for 3 turns.

gy_equip_hooded_lure.name: Hooded Lure
gy_equip_hooded_lure.description: Grants Tether: pull an enemy within 2-4 two tiles toward you.

hm_equip_tar_caulking.name: Tar Caulking
hm_equip_tar_caulking.description: +3 hp and resist 1 brine damage. Every seam on the bearer packed with hot tar and oakum.

hm_equip_filed_claw.name: Filed Claw
hm_equip_filed_claw.description: +1 attack. The inside edge of the big claw filed to a working edge on a wreck-rib.

hm_equip_spare_plating.name: Spare Plating
hm_equip_spare_plating.description: Grants Bolt On a Plate: repair your own shell by 5 (1 AP, cooldown 3). Does nothing for a bare crab.

hm_equip_grudge_ledger.name: Grudge Ledger
hm_equip_grudge_ledger.description: Grants Write It Down: Mark an enemy within 1-3 for 1 turn and give it 2 stacks of Grudge for 3 turns.

hm_equip_moulting_sac.name: Moulting Sac
hm_equip_moulting_sac.description: +2 hp, and the bearer returns once on death with 30 percent of its hp, having quietly grown a new skin.

hm_equip_brass_claw_cap.name: Brass Claw-Cap
hm_equip_brass_claw_cap.description: +2 attack. A ship's brass fender-cap hammered over the big claw.

sl_equip_lacquered_skin_coat.name: Lacquered Skin Coat
sl_equip_lacquered_skin_coat.description: +4 hp. A coat cut from an old skin of the wearer's own, lacquered hard with marsh resin.

sl_equip_fang_caps.name: Fang-Caps
sl_equip_fang_caps.description: Grants Capped Fang: deal attack-1 physical damage to an adjacent enemy and apply 1 Venom.

sl_equip_leviathan_scale.name: Leviathan Scale
sl_equip_leviathan_scale.description: +1 defense and resist 1 physical damage. One scale from a stranded leviathan, as wide as a door.

sl_equip_gourd_bandolier.name: Gourd Bandolier
sl_equip_gourd_bandolier.description: Grants Throw Gourd: deal attack-3 venom damage to an enemy within 2-3 and apply 1 Venom.

sl_equip_spare_skin.name: Spare Skin
sl_equip_spare_skin.description: +2 hp. Grants Grow a Spare Skin: once per battle, heal 3 and become able to Shed again. Best on a unit that can Shed.

sl_equip_eldest_hood.name: Hood of the Eldest
sl_equip_eldest_hood.description: +1 attack and +1 defense. A hood-skin from the library, lent to the bearer for one battle.
